name: Ethan Riley
bio:
Ethan Riley's motorsport journey began in rural New South Wales, tinkering with go-karts on his family's farm. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led him to pursue a mechanical engineering degree, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he joined a small V8 Supercar team as a data analyst, quickly proving his aptitude for translating technical data into actionable race strategies. 

His pragmatic approach, combined with a knack for identifying performance bottlenecks, propelled him through the ranks. Ethan prioritizes clear communication and data-driven decision-making, fostering a collaborative environment where every team member's input is valued. His ability to remain calm under pressure and make critical adjustments during a race has earned him a reputation as a highly effective sporting director. He stands out for his unconventional approach to pit stop strategy, often taking calculated risks to gain track position.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side
physical.description: Ethan is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of coffee brewed at a precise temperature before every race.
